SPMCP_fetch, SPMCP_install, SPMWB_store, and SPM_release enqueue on the regular L0->L1 request buffer because they interact with coherent memory or slot lifecycle
Responses arrive on the dedicated SPM response buffer from Ruby L1 and complete the Ruby sequencer without changing L0 cache state
